author: LifeHacks
body:
Hello, I'd like to appeal an unban because I believe I was banned wrongfully.

Name: LifeHacks

Reason I was banned: Speed Hacks (August 3rd)

Why I should be un-banned: I think I should be un-banned because I have never hacked on avic.us and I did not on August 3rd. Though I don't have evidence, if I do recall I didn't play in August much if at all. You can check the console, but I swear I didn't hack. If it helps, which I don't think it will, but I'm taking precautions, the person who banned me was a Diamond rank "GalaxyBrit."

Kind regards,
               LifeHacks

P.S: If I missed anything let me know. Sorry for no evidence, I couldn't get any.
